sources.entry: ANYbotics ANYmal - A quadruped robot from ANYbotics designed for inspection tasks in industrial environments, including oil, gas, and mining facilities.

summary.name: ANYmal
summary.one_liner: ANYmal is a quadruped inspection robot from ANYbotics, built for autonomous data collection in industrial plants with visual, thermal, and acoustic sensors.
use_cases: inspection rounds in oil, gas, and mining sites
summary.what_it_does: ANYmal is a legged inspection robot with an IP67 rating for dust and water protection. It comes with integrated visual and thermal cameras, an ultrasonic microphone, an LED spotlight, and lidar, and its payload can be extended by about 10 kg for gas sensing or acoustic imaging. It navigates autonomously, including stairs, multi-floor plants, and wet or uneven terrain, and it docks itself to recharge at low battery. The page also describes an operations platform for planning robot missions, spotting failing equipment, and turning findings into work orders.
notable: IP67-rated, ruggedized quadruped with a turn-key inspection sensor suite
Automatic docking and range extension via multiple docking stations
360° lidar, 6 depth cameras, and 2 teleoperation cameras for navigation
Operations platform linking robot findings to maintenance work orders
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; it is a sales-driven product
Walking range is about 2 km per charge (90–120 min), and a full charge takes 3 hours
Gas sensing and acoustic imaging are add-on integrations rather than built-in
